protocol.name: refurs_shell_unstable_v1

description.summary: desktop state for the RefursWM bar

protocol.description:
A private protocol between RefursWM and its bar (RefursLine). It is offered only on a connection RefursWM opened itself for a program with a grant for the `shell` capability (WAYLAND_SOCKET); no other client and no sandbox ever sees the global.
State arrives as events; a burst of changes ends with zrefurs_shell_v1.done, and a client applies everything it got up to that event at once. Nothing is polled: an idle desktop sends nothing.

interface.name: zrefurs_shell_v1

description.summary: desktop state and actions

interface.description: Right after the bind the compositor sends the whole state followed by done.

description.summary: a bar menu a key binding asks for

request.name: get_output

description.summary: per-monitor state

request.description: Workspace and layout mode of one monitor, and the actions that act on it.

end the session

event.name: workspaces

description.summary: which workspaces have windows

event.description: Bit n is set when workspace n (0-based) has at least one window.

event.name: focus

description.summary: the focused window

event.description: Empty strings when no window has the focus. Valid UTF-8 without control characters, at most 255 bytes each.

event.name: keyboard_layout

description.summary: the active keyboard layout

event.description: index: the xkb group; name: its entry in the compositor's layout list ("us", "ru").

event.name: theme

description.summary: dark or light

event.description: dark: 1 for the dark scheme. Only the scheme is shared: RefursWM and the bar each have their own colours.
